items.title: Why Luxury Escapes Puts Its Best Prices Behind a Paywall
items.summary: Travel customers switch platforms on price and inventory with little friction, and Luxury Escapes’ CEO builds around that. His bet is a paid membership with a genuine paywall over partner pricing, a moat he expects to matter more as AI agents enter booking.

items.title: The New Math Behind Travel’s AI Roll-Ups
items.summary: AI could give travel consolidators a new way to improve the companies they buy. The question is whether the gains are real, repeatable, and worth the price of admission.

items.title: Airbnb.org Aims for 1 Million Free Nights a Year, Funded Partly by a Dime a Booking
items.summary: Is 10 cents per booking enough of a contribution? Well, it's more than Booking.com and Vrbo donate per stay.

items.title: Waymo Picks Ramp for Its First Business Travel Expense Partner: Exclusive
items.summary: Waymo’s receipts will now flow straight into a spend platform used by more than 70,000 businesses. That should fix a pain point for road warriors, and it’s a signal that Waymo wants a bigger slice of corporate travel.

items.title: Agoda Plugs Into Meta’s Muse in Singapore and Japan
items.summary: Agoda gives Booking Holdings a foothold in Meta’s Muse in Singapore and Japan, while Expedia holds the hotel slot in North America. The real question is the economics: if Meta takes a fee, hotels could pay twice for the same booking.

items.title: Travel Companies and DMOs Work to Patch Critical PHP Flaws
items.summary: The scramble to patch a security flaw shows just how much smaller players in travel depend on outside vendors to keep their websites safe.

items.title: Saudi Giga Project Spending Shrinks. Hotel Developers Keep Building
items.summary: Saudi Arabia is shrinking giga project budgets on Riyadh’s event deadlines. Hotel developers are still building as if the old plan held, with pipelines up and skewed to luxury. That mismatch, plus cost inflation and security risk, is the bigger story for owners and brands.

items.title: Airbnb to Require Temporary Phone Numbers for Large Hosts and Guests
items.summary: Airbnb says the temporary phone numbers are meant to protect privacy. But the change also makes it harder for property managers to turn Airbnb guests into direct bookers.
